# 1. LIBRARIES
```{r}
library(tidyverse) 
library(readxl)
library(jsonlite)
library(DESeq2)
library(msigdbr)
library(fgsea)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(limma)
library(BiocParallel)
```

# 2. CLEANING FUNCTIONS (Input Standardization)
```{r}
clean_identifiers <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x <- gsub(" ", "_", x)       
  x <- make.names(x)           
  x <- gsub("\\.", "_", x)     
  return(x)
}

.read_flexible <- function(path) {
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(path))
  
  if (ext %in% c("csv", "tsv", "txt")) {
    first_line <- readLines(path, n = 1, warn = FALSE)
    
    if (grepl("\t", first_line)) {
      df <- readr::read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
    } else if (grepl(";", first_line)) {
      df <- readr::read_csv2(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
    } else {
      df <- readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
    }
    
  } else if (ext %in% c("xlsx", "xls")) {
    df <- readxl::read_excel(path)
  } else if (ext == "json") {
    df <- jsonlite::fromJSON(path, flatten = TRUE)
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported file format: ", ext)
  }
  
  return(as.data.frame(df))
}

.convert_gene_ids <- function(gene_vector) {
  gene_vector <- trimws(as.character(gene_vector))
  gene_vector_clean <- gsub("\\..*$", "", gene_vector)
  test_genes <- head(gene_vector, 20)
  
  if (any(grepl("^ENSG", test_genes))) {
    mapped <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = gene_vector_clean,
                                    column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first")
    mapped[is.na(mapped)] <- gene_vector[is.na(mapped)]
    return(unname(mapped))
  }
  if (any(grepl("^\\d+$", test_genes))) {
    mapped <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = gene_vector_clean,
                                    column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENTREZID", multiVals = "first")
    mapped[is.na(mapped)] <- gene_vector[is.na(mapped)]
    return(unname(mapped))
  }
  return(gene_vector)
}
```

# 3. IMPORT FUNCTIONS
```{r}
import_expression <- function(path, gene_col = 1, is_microarray = FALSE) {
  df <- .read_flexible(path)
  
  if (is.character(gene_col)) gene_col <- clean_identifiers(gene_col)
  colnames(df) <- clean_identifiers(colnames(df))
  gene_col_name <- if(is.numeric(gene_col)) colnames(df)[gene_col] else gene_col
  
  genes <- df[[gene_col_name]]
  expr_data <- df[, colnames(df) != gene_col_name, drop = FALSE]
  
  expr_data <- as.data.frame(lapply(expr_data, function(col) {
    if (is.character(col)) {
      col <- gsub(",", ".", col) # Correggi virgole italiane
    }
    as.numeric(as.character(col)) # Force conversion to numeric
  }))
  
  clean_genes <- .convert_gene_ids(genes)
  expr_data$GENE_ID <- clean_genes
  
  if (is_microarray) {
    expr_clean <- expr_data %>%
      group_by(GENE_ID) %>%
      summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
      ungroup() %>% as.data.frame()
  } else {
    expr_clean <- expr_data %>%
      group_by(GENE_ID) %>%
      summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ as.integer(round(sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))))) %>%
      ungroup() %>% as.data.frame()
  }
  
  rownames(expr_clean) <- expr_clean$GENE_ID
  expr_clean$GENE_ID <- NULL
  return(expr_clean)
}

import_metadata <- function(path, sample_col = 1, condition_col = NULL) {
  df <- .read_flexible(path)
  
  if (is.character(sample_col)) sample_col <- clean_identifiers(sample_col)
  if (!is.null(condition_col) && is.character(condition_col)) condition_col <- clean_identifiers(condition_col)
  
  colnames(df) <- clean_identifiers(colnames(df))
  sample_col_name <- if(is.numeric(sample_col)) colnames(df)[sample_col] else sample_col
  
  df[[sample_col_name]] <- clean_identifiers(df[[sample_col_name]])
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  rownames(df) <- df[[sample_col_name]]
  
  if (!is.null(condition_col)) {
    condition_col_name <- if(is.numeric(condition_col)) colnames(df)[condition_col] else condition_col
    df$condition <- df[[condition_col_name]]
  }
  
  df[, sample_col_name] <- NULL
  df <- df %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ clean_identifiers(.x)))
  return(df)
}

# Automatic extraction of group labels from the metadata: returns the unique groups (conditions) available, so the user can pick 2 (or more, for pairwise comparisons) without typing them by hand.
get_available_groups <- function(metadata) {
  if (!"condition" %in% colnames(metadata)) {
    stop("The 'condition' column is not present in the metadata. Did you specify condition_col in import_metadata()?")
  }
  groups <- sort(unique(as.character(metadata$condition)))
  n_samples <- table(as.character(metadata$condition))
  
  cat(">>> Groups available in the dataset:\n")
  for (g in groups) {
    cat(sprintf(" - %s (n = %d samples)\n", g, n_samples[g]))
  }
  
  if (length(groups) < 2) {
    warning("Warning: only one group was found. 2 groups are needed for a DEA comparison.")
  }
  
  return(groups)
}
```

# 4. DEA ENGINE
```{r}
# Validation of the contrast chosen by the user: checks that EXACTLY 2 groups were chosen among those actually present in the metadata, before launching DESeq2/limma.
validate_contrast <- function(metadata, contrast) {
  if (!"condition" %in% colnames(metadata)) {
    stop("The 'condition' column is not present in the metadata.")
  }
  groups <- unique(as.character(metadata$condition))
  
  if (length(contrast) != 2) {
    stop("The contrast must contain EXACTLY 2 groups (e.g. c('Diseased','Healthy')). ",
         "For multiple comparisons across more groups, use run_all_pairwise_comparisons().")
  }
  if (!all(contrast %in% groups)) {
    missing <- contrast[!contrast %in% groups]
    stop("Group(s) not found in the metadata: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
         "\nAvailable groups: ", paste(groups, collapse = ", "))
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

run_differential_expression <- function(expr_matrix, metadata, method = "RNAseq", contrast = c("treated", "control"), min_counts = 10) {
  # Validation of the user-chosen comparison against the real labels in the metadata
  validate_contrast(metadata, contrast)
  
  samples_intersect <- intersect(colnames(expr_matrix), rownames(metadata))
  expr_matrix <- expr_matrix[, samples_intersect]
  metadata <- metadata[samples_intersect, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Keep ONLY the samples of the 2 selected groups: any other group present in the metadata is excluded from normalization, dispersion estimation / variance modelling and filtering, so it cannot influence the result.
  keep <- as.character(metadata$condition) %in% contrast
  expr_matrix <- expr_matrix[, rownames(metadata)[keep], drop = FALSE]
  metadata <- metadata[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  metadata$condition <- factor(as.character(metadata$condition), levels = c(contrast[2], contrast[1]))
  message(">>> Samples used: ", paste(contrast[1], sum(metadata$condition == contrast[1]), sep = "="),
          ", ", paste(contrast[2], sum(metadata$condition == contrast[2]), sep = "="))
  
  if (method == "RNAseq") {
    message(">>> Running DESeq2 modelling for RNA-seq...")
    dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = expr_matrix, colData = metadata, design = ~ condition)
    # Pre-filter: minimum total counts per gene (computed on the 2 selected groups only; default 10).
    dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= min_counts, ]
    if (nrow(dds) < 2) stop("Fewer than 2 genes pass the minimum counts filter (", min_counts, "). Lower the threshold.")
    
    dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
    dds <- tryCatch({
      estimateDispersions(dds)
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(">>> [Note] The parametric fit failed. Trying the local fit...")
      tryCatch({
        estimateDispersions(dds, fitType = "local")
      }, error = function(e2) {
        message(">>> [Note] Applying fitType = 'mean'...")
        estimateDispersions(dds, fitType = "mean")
      })
    })
    dds <- nbinomWaldTest(dds)
    
    res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", contrast[1], contrast[2]))
    res_standard <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("GeneID") %>%
      transmute(GeneID, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj, stat)
    
  } else if (method == "Microarray") {
    message(">>> Running limma modelling for Microarray...")
    design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + condition, data = metadata)
    colnames(design) <- gsub("condition", "", colnames(design))
    
    fit <- lmFit(expr_matrix, design)
    contrast_formula <- paste(contrast[1], "-", contrast[2], sep = "")
    contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_formula, levels = design)
    
    fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
    fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
    
    res <- topTable(fit2, coef = 1, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
    res_standard <- res %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("GeneID") %>%
      transmute(GeneID, log2FoldChange = logFC, pvalue = P.Value, padj = adj.P.Val, stat = t)
  } else {
    stop("Invalid method: choose 'RNAseq' or 'Microarray'")
  }
  
  return(res_standard)
}

# Pairwise comparisons across all available groups, useful when the metadata has more than 2 groups (e.g. Healthy, Drug_low, Drug_high) and all pairwise combinations are wanted (DESeq2/limma always compare 2 groups at a time).
run_all_pairwise_comparisons <- function(expr_matrix, metadata, method = "RNAseq") {
  groups <- get_available_groups(metadata)
  if (length(groups) < 2) stop("At least 2 groups are needed for a comparison.")
  
  pairs <- combn(groups, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  results_list <- list()
  
  for (p in pairs) {
    label <- paste(p[1], "vs", p[2])
    message(">>> Confronto: ", label)
    results_list[[label]] <- run_differential_expression(expr_matrix, metadata,
                                                           method = method, contrast = p)
  }
  return(results_list)  # named list: results_list[["Drug vs Control"]]
}
```

# 5. PLOT AND TABLE FUNCTIONS
```{r}
plot_universal_volcano <- function(res_tbl, padj_cutoff = 0.05, lfc_cutoff = 1, title = "Volcano Plot") {
  df_plot <- res_tbl %>%
    mutate(status = case_when(
      is.na(padj) ~ "Not Significant",
      padj < padj_cutoff & log2FoldChange >= lfc_cutoff ~ "Upregulated",
      padj < padj_cutoff & log2FoldChange <= -lfc_cutoff ~ "Downregulated",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    ))
  
  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = status), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "red", "Downregulated" = "blue", "Not Significant" = "grey70")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = title, x = "log2 Fold Change", y = "-log10 Adjusted P-value") +
    theme_minimal()
}

plot_universal_pca <- function(expr_matrix, metadata, title = "PCA Plot") {
  if (all(expr_matrix %% 1 == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    expr_matrix <- log2(expr_matrix + 1)
  }
  
  gene_variances <- apply(expr_matrix, 1, var)
  expr_matrix <- expr_matrix[gene_variances > 0 & !is.na(gene_variances), ]
  
  if (nrow(expr_matrix) == 0) {
    stop("Error: all genes have zero variance. Check the input data.")
  }
  
  pca_res <- prcomp(t(expr_matrix), scale. = TRUE)
  percentVar <- round(100 * (pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)))
  
  pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
    inner_join(tibble::rownames_to_column(metadata, "SampleID"), by = "SampleID")
  
  ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = condition)) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "%")) +
    ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "%")) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_minimal()
}

generate_ranked_gene_table <- function(res_tbl, padj_cutoff = 0.05) {
  res_tbl %>%
    filter(!is.na(pvalue)) %>%
    mutate(
      Regulation = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "UP-regulated", "DOWN-regulated"),
      Significant = case_when(
        is.na(padj) ~ "NA",
        padj < padj_cutoff ~ "Yes",
        TRUE ~ "No"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(GeneID, Regulation, Significant, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj, stat) %>%
    arrange(desc(Significant == "Yes"), padj, desc(abs(log2FoldChange)))
}
```

# 6. ENRICHMENT FUNCTIONS

## 6a. ORA (Over-Representation Analysis)
```{r}
# ORA: tests whether a set of genes (DEGs selected from the DE results, or a list supplied by the user) is over-represented in each MSigDB pathway (hypergeometric test via clusterProfiler::enricher).
#
# - gene_list = NULL  -> genes are selected from res_tbl using padj_cutoff / lfc_cutoff / direction
# - gene_list = c(...) -> ORA on a list of specific genes chosen by the user (symbols, Ensembl or Entrez)
# - direction: "all" (UP + DOWN), "up" (UP-regulated only), "down" (DOWN-regulated only); applies only if gene_list = NULL
#
# The universe (background) is all genes actually tested in the DEA (non-NA pvalue): using the whole genome as background
# would give biased results, because unexpressed/filtered genes could never have come out as DE.
run_ora_analysis <- function(res_tbl, gene_list = NULL, direction = c("all", "up", "down"),
                             padj_cutoff = 0.05, lfc_cutoff = 1,
                             category = "H", subcategory = NULL, species = "Homo sapiens",
                             min_size = 15, max_size = 500, pvalue_cutoff = 0.05) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  
  # Universe: all genes tested in the DEA
  universe <- unique(res_tbl$GeneID[!is.na(res_tbl$pvalue)])
  
  # Selection of input genes
  if (is.null(gene_list)) {
    sel <- res_tbl %>% filter(!is.na(padj), padj < padj_cutoff)
    sel <- switch(direction,
      "all"  = sel %>% filter(abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_cutoff),
      "up"   = sel %>% filter(log2FoldChange >= lfc_cutoff),
      "down" = sel %>% filter(log2FoldChange <= -lfc_cutoff)
    )
    input_genes <- unique(sel$GeneID)
    origin <- sprintf("DEG (%s, padj < %.2f, |log2FC| >= %.1f)", direction, padj_cutoff, lfc_cutoff)
  } else {
    input_genes <- unique(.convert_gene_ids(gene_list))
    origin <- "user-supplied gene list"
  }
  
  # Keep only genes present in the universe (hypergeometric requirement)
  n_before <- length(input_genes)
  input_genes <- intersect(input_genes, universe)
  if (length(input_genes) < n_before) {
    message(sprintf(">>> [Note] %d of %d genes are not in the tested universe and were excluded from the ORA.",
                    n_before - length(input_genes), n_before))
  }
  
  if (length(input_genes) < 5) {
    warning(sprintf("Only %d genes available for the ORA (%s): too few for a reliable test. ORA not run.",
                    length(input_genes), origin))
    return(NULL)
  }
  message(sprintf(">>> ORA on %d genes [%s] - universe: %d genes", length(input_genes), origin, length(universe)))
  
  # MSigDB gene sets
  if (is.null(subcategory)) {
    m_df <- msigdbr(species = species, category = category)
  } else {
    m_df <- msigdbr(species = species, category = category, subcategory = subcategory)
  }
  term2gene <- m_df %>% dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>% distinct()
  
  ora <- clusterProfiler::enricher(
    gene          = input_genes,
    universe      = universe,
    TERM2GENE     = term2gene,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff  = 1,   # no internal filter: the significance cutoff is handled downstream
    qvalueCutoff  = 1,
    minGSSize     = min_size,
    maxGSSize     = max_size
  )
  
  if (is.null(ora) || nrow(ora@result) == 0) {
    warning("No testable pathway for the ORA with these parameters.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  ora_res <- ora@result %>%
    mutate(
      GeneRatioNum = sapply(strsplit(GeneRatio, "/"), function(x) as.numeric(x[1]) / as.numeric(x[2])),
      BgRatioNum   = sapply(strsplit(BgRatio, "/"), function(x) as.numeric(x[1]) / as.numeric(x[2])),
      FoldEnrichment = GeneRatioNum / BgRatioNum
    ) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust, pvalue)
  
  # Direction: ORA does NOT provide it (it is a test on an unordered set of genes). We derive it a posteriori
  # by counting, among the genes supporting each pathway, how many have log2FC > 0 (UP) and how many < 0 (DOWN) in the DEA.
  lfc_lookup <- setNames(res_tbl$log2FoldChange, res_tbl$GeneID)
  dir_counts <- lapply(strsplit(ora_res$geneID, "/"), function(g) {
    l <- lfc_lookup[g]
    c(up = sum(l > 0, na.rm = TRUE), down = sum(l < 0, na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  ora_res$N_UP   <- unname(sapply(dir_counts, `[`, "up"))
  ora_res$N_DOWN <- unname(sapply(dir_counts, `[`, "down"))
  frac_up <- ora_res$N_UP / pmax(ora_res$N_UP + ora_res$N_DOWN, 1)
  ora_res$Direction <- case_when(frac_up >= 0.8 ~ "UP", frac_up <= 0.2 ~ "DOWN", TRUE ~ "MIXED")
  
  attr(ora_res, "n_input_genes") <- length(input_genes)
  attr(ora_res, "origin") <- origin
  
  return(ora_res)
}

# ORA plot. Two modes:
# - type = "bar" (default): significance is the LENGTH of the bar (-log10 padj), i.e. a position on a common axis,
#   which is the most precise and least subjective visual encoding. Each bar explicitly reports k/K, fold enrichment and padj.
# - type = "dot": classic dotplot (colour = padj, size = n. genes), kept for comparison.
plot_ora <- function(ora_res, type = c("bar", "dot"), top_n = 20, padj_cutoff = 0.05,
                     title = "Top Enriched Pathways (ORA)") {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  if (is.null(ora_res) || nrow(ora_res) == 0) {
    warning("No ORA results to plot.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  n_signif <- sum(ora_res$p.adjust < padj_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (n_signif == 0) {
    warning(sprintf("No pathway has padj < %.2f. Showing the top %d pathways by p-value anyway (not significant, exploratory use only).",
                     padj_cutoff, top_n))
    plot_data <- ora_res %>% head(top_n)
    subtitle_txt <- "No significant pathway (exploratory only)"
  } else {
    if (n_signif < top_n) {
      message(sprintf(">>> Only %d of the %d requested pathways have padj < %.2f. Showing only those.",
                       n_signif, top_n, padj_cutoff))
    }
    plot_data <- ora_res %>% filter(p.adjust < padj_cutoff) %>% head(top_n)
    subtitle_txt <- sprintf("Pathways with padj < %.2f", padj_cutoff)
  }
  
  n_in <- attr(ora_res, "n_input_genes")
  if (!is.null(n_in)) subtitle_txt <- paste0(subtitle_txt, " | input genes: ", n_in)
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      Description = gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", ID),
      Description = gsub("^GOBP_", "", Description),
      Description = gsub("_", " ", Description),
      SetSize     = as.numeric(sub("/.*$", "", BgRatio)),          # K: pathway genes present in the universe
      neglog10    = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, 1e-300)),                 # avoids Inf if padj = 0
      Label   = sprintf("%d/%d genes (%d UP, %d DOWN) | FE %.1f | padj %.1e",
                            Count, SetSize, N_UP, N_DOWN, FoldEnrichment, p.adjust),
      Description = reorder(Description, neglog10)
    )
  
  if (type == "bar") {
    ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = neglog10, y = Description, fill = Direction)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("UP" = "firebrick", "DOWN" = "steelblue", "MIXED" = "grey60"),
                        name = "Direction\n(>= 80% of genes)") +
      geom_text(aes(label = Label), hjust = -0.05, size = 3) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(padj_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
      scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.45))) +
      labs(x = expression(-log[10]~"(padj)"), y = NULL, title = title,
           subtitle = subtitle_txt,
           caption = sprintf("Dashed line: padj = %.2f | k/K = input genes / pathway genes in the universe | FE = fold enrichment", padj_cutoff)) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
  } else {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>% mutate(Description = reorder(Description, GeneRatioNum))
    ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = GeneRatioNum, y = Description)) +
      geom_point(aes(size = Count, color = p.adjust)) +
      scale_color_gradient(low = "firebrick", high = "steelblue", name = "padj") +
      scale_size_continuous(name = "N. genes") +
      labs(x = "Gene Ratio", y = NULL, title = title, subtitle = subtitle_txt) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"))
  }
}
```

## 6b. GSEA
```{r}
run_gsea_analysis <- function(res_tbl, category = "H", subcategory = NULL, species = "Homo sapiens") {
  ranks <- res_tbl$stat
  names(ranks) <- res_tbl$GeneID
  ranks <- ranks[!is.na(ranks)]
  ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  if (is.null(subcategory)) {
    m_df <- msigdbr(species = species, category = category)
  } else {
    m_df <- msigdbr(species = species, category = category, subcategory = subcategory)
  }
  
  pathways <- split(x = m_df$gene_symbol, f = m_df$gs_name)
  
  set.seed(42)
  fgsea_res <- fgseaMultilevel(pathways = pathways, stats = ranks, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500,
                               BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam())
  
  fgsea_res <- fgsea_res %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(NES)))
  
  return(fgsea_res)
}

plot_top_pathways <- function(fgsea_res, top_n = 20, padj_cutoff = 0.05, title = "Top Modulated Pathways (GSEA)") {
  
  n_signif <- sum(fgsea_res$padj < padj_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (n_signif == 0) {
    warning(sprintf("No pathway has padj < %.2f. Showing the top %d pathways by absolute NES anyway (not significant, exploratory use only).",
                     padj_cutoff, top_n))
    plot_data <- fgsea_res %>% filter(!is.na(NES)) %>% head(top_n)
  } else if (n_signif < top_n) {
    message(sprintf(">>> Only %d of the %d requested pathways have padj < %.2f. Showing only those.",
                     n_signif, top_n, padj_cutoff))
    plot_data <- fgsea_res %>% filter(!is.na(NES), padj < padj_cutoff)
  } else {
    plot_data <- fgsea_res %>% filter(!is.na(NES), padj < padj_cutoff) %>% head(top_n)
  }
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(pathway = gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", pathway)) %>% 
    mutate(pathway = gsub("^GOBP_", "", pathway)) %>%
    mutate(pathway = gsub("_", " ", pathway)) %>%
    mutate(Direction = ifelse(NES > 0, "Up-regulated", "Down-regulated")) %>%
    mutate(pathway = reorder(pathway, NES))
  
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = NES, y = pathway, fill = Direction)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Up-regulated" = "firebrick", "Down-regulated" = "steelblue")) +
    labs(x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)", y = NULL,
         title = title,
         subtitle = sprintf("Pathways with padj < %.2f", padj_cutoff)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```

# 7. SIMULATION AND FULL TEST
```{r}
# --- PIPELINE START ---

# 1. Data loading
counts <- import_expression("C:\\Users\\maran\\Downloads\\counts_test.tsv", gene_col = 1, is_microarray = FALSE)
metadata <- import_metadata("C:\\Users\\maran\\Downloads\\metadata_test.tsv", sample_col = 1, condition_col = 2)

# Extraction of available groups -> the user picks the two groups to compare here 
available_groups <- get_available_groups(metadata)

# 2. Exploratory PCA Plot
print(plot_universal_pca(counts, metadata, title = "PCA of Count Data"))

# 3. Differential Analysis
# The user chooses the contrast among the groups printed above in available_groups. If the chosen groups do not exist, validate_contrast() stops execution with a message.
res_tbl <- run_differential_expression(counts, metadata, method = "RNAseq", contrast = c("Drug", "Control"))

# 3b. (Optional) If there are more than 2 groups and ALL pairwise comparisons are wanted:
# all_comparisons <- run_all_pairwise_comparisons(counts, metadata, method = "RNAseq")
# all_comparisons[["Drug vs Control"]]  # access a specific comparison

# 4. Volcano Plot
print(plot_universal_volcano(res_tbl, title = "Volcano Plot - Output Standardizzato"))

# 5. Gene Table Generation and Export
cat("\n>>> GENERATING THE SORTED GENERAL RESULTS TABLE <<<\n")
risultati_ordinati <- generate_ranked_gene_table(res_tbl)
print(head(risultati_ordinati, 10))
write.csv(risultati_ordinati, "Risultati_Finali_DE_Ranked.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 6. ORA (Over-Representation Analysis) - run BEFORE the GSEA, but not an alternative to it
cat("\n>>> Running ORA on the Hallmark pathways (MSigDB)...\n")

# 6a. ORA on the DEGs (UP + DOWN together) selected with the padj and log2FC cutoffs
ora_results <- run_ora_analysis(res_tbl, direction = "all",
                                padj_cutoff = 0.05, lfc_cutoff = 1, category = "H")

if (!is.null(ora_results)) {
  print(head(ora_results %>% dplyr::select(ID, Count, GeneRatio, BgRatio, FoldEnrichment, pvalue, p.adjust), 10))
  write.csv(ora_results, "Risultati_ORA.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  print(plot_ora(ora_results, top_n = 15, title = "Top 15 Enriched Pathways (ORA - Hallmark)"))
}
```
